name: Wall of Water
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

You create a wall of water within medium range that is 10 ft high, 5 ft thick, and up to 30 ft long or a circular wall with a diameter of short range. Uncheck any number of Conditions and roll Spirit to set the Difficulty.

Each creature that enters the wall or is within the wall when it's created must roll Strength against the Difficulty. On a failure, the creature takes 1d8 damage and is pushed out of the wall, away from you. On a pass, it takes half damage and is pushed out of the wall in a direction it chooses.

For each Condition you unchecked (twice for Insecure), choose one:

  • The wall becomes 10 ft longer or taller, or the diameter increases by 10 ft.

  • +1d damage.

  • Whenever you maintain concentration for this spell, you may move the wall or part of the wall an additional 5 ft in any direction you choose.

Describe how you create the wall.
successes:
✨: Whenever a creature fails its roll against the Difficulty, it is knocked prone.

🌞: Whenever a creature fails its roll against the Difficulty, a randomly-chosen item the creature is wielding is pulled from its grip and remains floating inside the wall.
